versions.name: Mammal Study
versions.description: Learn what sets mammals apart and how they are classified, then spend hours in the field logging species and signs, trace a carnivore's food chain, and carry out a project that helps local populations.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
